title: Final Project: Dashboard Layout
instructions:
Final challenge: Assemble the entire application

Your task is to transform the broken HTML code into a modern Dashboard. You will need to use everything you know about CSS Grid, Flexbox, and Absolute Positioning.

  • .app-container: The entire application runs in a wrapper. Use Flexbox so that the Sidebar and Main Content are nicely side-by-side. Ensure the application takes up the full height of the screen (100vh).
  • .sidebar: Use Flexbox (with column direction) so the menu items are stacked. Then, push them apart so the logout button goes all the way to the bottom.
  • .main-content: Command it to occupy all the remaining space (use flex-grow: 1 or flex: 1).
  • .stats-grid: Set this area as a CSS Grid. Split it into 3 equally wide columns.
  • .user-profile: Use Flexbox to align the name and the bell vertically to the center.
  • .badge (The hardest part!):
    • The red notification bubble needs to float. Give it position: absolute; (its parent is already set to relative).
    • Move it to the top right corner (top: -5px and right: -5px).
    • Set its design: width: 18px, height: 18px, red background (#ef4444), white text (color: white), font size to 12px, and make it fully rounded (circle).
    • Finally, apply Flexbox directly to this badge to perfectly center the number inside (both horizontally and vertically).
